text:
zoe: Heads up: mobile-sampleapp showing corrupt JSON after suspend/resume during streaming. looks like SSE data lines are being split and later concatenated incorrectly. repro below.
matt: repro'd on Android 12 emulator. saw unexpected joins across seq fields.
zoe: raw capture (trimmed):\n\n---chunk A---\ndata: {\"seq\":42,\"text\":\"hello\"}\r\ndata: {\"seq\":43,\"text\":\"par\"\r\n---chunk B---\ndata: t2\"}\r\n\n---observed merge---\nseq43.text => "par\"\n\"t2" => invalid JSON and wrong content.
ravi: classic TCP/proxy split. fastly/edge-proxy may coalesce or cut mid-line. our client currently treats any incoming bytes and splits on `\n\n` to delimit events, but if a `data:` line is broken we try to join blindly which causes cross-event mixing.
matt: any recent proxy changes? infra-bot can you check edge-proxy config?
infra-bot: edge-proxy v1.12 in staging; no recent changes to streaming pipeline. forwarding rules unchanged.
zoe: two actionable proposals: (A) server emits an `_fragment` event when it detects an unterminated `data:` line at socket close so clients can reassemble safely, or (B) change SDK behavior to surface partial fragments and let apps decide how to join.
ravi: prefer both: server sentinel + SDK opt-in flag. server sentinel helps thin clients too (curl etc.). sketch: on connection close, if buffer has unterminated data content, emit: `event: _incomplete\ndata: <base64-payload>\n\n`. clients can base64-decode and join by seq id.
matt: downside: more events means more overhead. but it's lightweight. we should also consider heartbeats to avoid proxies treating long idle as EOF. cheap: `event: hb\ndata: \n\n` every 10s when streaming long responses.
zoe: agree on heartbeat being configurable per route. also need SDK parity: JS and Android currently auto-join partials; Go emits onPartial. we should standardize to expose `sse.partial_policy` with options ["auto_join", "emit_incomplete_event", "emit_partial_callback"]. default for now stays backward-compatible but document it.
mobile-qa: I'll add an e2e case: background app for 20s then resume and assert no crossing of seq ids. will test against fastly staging.
ravi: runtime patch pseudo:
```
if (socketClosing && dataLineOpen) {
  emit("event: _incomplete\n");
  emit("data: " + base64(dataLine) + "\n\n");
}
```
plus optional heartbeat sender.
matt: SDK change: expose flag and add `onIncomplete` callback. default false. also add `experimental.sseHeartbeatInterval` in client config.
zoe: QA and perf: emitting base64 fragments means some clients will need to decode; ensure we version this and gate behind a feature flag for hosted routes. don't break existing users.
infra-bot: created task: FRAG-2026 add sentinel fragments + heartbeat (https://goto/tasks/FRAG-2026).
mobile-qa: I'll attach reproducer app and logs to FRAG-2026. steps: 1) start sampleapp streaming, 2) background for 20s, 3) resume and capture network buffer.
matt: I'll prepare runtime PR and coordinate with SDK owners for parallel changes. tag @ravi for parser review.
ravi: will review runtime PR; pay attention to minimal allocations when base64-encoding to avoid perf regressions. also add metrics: fragment_count, incomplete_event_emitted.
zoe: thanks. follow-ups: runtime PR, SDK opt-in flag + docs, QA e2e, incident update if customer reports match. posting logs to FRAG-2026 now. :sparkles:
